zh.title: 華航規劃放大名古屋航線機型並推亞運應援物
zh.summary: 華航規劃於9月17日至10月5日間安排7班次放大名古屋航線執飛機型
body: 中華航空於9月7日宣布，為迎接即將舉辦的2026愛知名古屋亞洲運動會，規劃於9月17日至10月5日間，安排7個班次放大機型執飛往返名古屋的航班。此舉旨在為代表團與旅客提供更舒適的座位空間，並提升行李載運容量。
此外，華航自即日起至10月5日推出限定亞運主題應援物品。其中電子登機證適用於桃園往返日本全航線，旅客可透過 CI Mobile App 取得。名古屋航線亦提供限定頭墊紙、枕頭套以及專屬餐飲，為台灣參賽選手加油。

en.title: China Airlines to Deploy Larger Aircraft on Nagoya Route for Asian Games
en.summary: China Airlines plans larger aircraft on Nagoya flights from September 17 to October 5.
body: China Airlines announced on September 7 that it plans to deploy larger aircraft for seven flights on its Nagoya route between September 17 and October 5, 2026. The operational adjustment aims to provide comfortable seating and increased baggage capacity for the Taiwan delegation and travelers attending the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games.

Additionally, the airline is introducing limited-edition Asian Games-themed cheering items from now until October 5. These include electronic boarding passes available via the CI Mobile App for all routes between Taoyuan and Japan. The Nagoya route will also feature themed headrest covers, pillowcases, and specially designed inflight menus to support the athletes.

zh.title: 印尼火山噴發影響雅加達機場 華航長榮取消往返航班
zh.summary: 因印尼喀拉喀托之子火山爆發影響，中華航空與長榮航空9月7日取消雅加達往返航班。
body: 印尼喀拉喀托之子火山持續噴發，導致雅加達蘇卡諾-哈達國際機場因偵測到火山灰一度暫停起降並延長關閉，衝擊當地與周邊航點營運。
受火山灰影響，中華航空於9月7日取消CI761與CI762桃園往返雅加達航班；為疏運旅客，華航預計於9月8日針對CI763與CI764桃園往返雅加達航班改以放大機型營運。
長榮航空亦於9月7日取消BR238D、BR237D、BR238及BR237雅加達往返台北航班。此外，星宇航空表示受火山爆發影響，部分航班可能有所異動，提醒旅客注意班機更新資訊。

en.title: Taiwan Carriers Cancel Jakarta Flights Following Volcanic Ash Eruption
en.summary: China Airlines and EVA Air canceled Jakarta flights on September 7 due to volcanic ash activity.
body: The ongoing eruption of Indonesia's Anak Krakatau volcano caused volcanic ash detection at Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, leading to a temporary suspension of flights and extended closure of the main facility.

In response to the volcanic activity, China Airlines canceled its CI761 and CI762 flights between Taoyuan and Jakarta on September 7. To accommodate affected passengers, the carrier plans to operate larger aircraft for its CI763 and CI764 services between Taoyuan and Jakarta on September 8.

EVA Air also canceled its flights BR238D, BR237D, BR238, and BR237 operating between Jakarta and Taipei on September 7. Additionally, STARLUX Airlines announced that some of its flights may experience adjustments due to the volcanic eruption.

zh.title: 星宇航空10月起調漲訂位服務費至33美元 國籍航空今年陸續跟進
zh.summary: 星宇航空10月7日起調升訂位費至33美元；多間國籍航空今年亦陸續調漲。
body: 星宇航空宣布，將自2026年10月7日起調漲訂位服務費，自現行的30美元（約新台幣950元）調高至33美元（約新台幣1046元）。該費用係透過全球分銷系統（GDS）提供服務並隨機票收取。這也是星宇航空繼今年4月將費用自25美元調升至30美元後，第二度宣布調漲。
今年多家國籍航空亦陸續調漲費用。台灣虎航自9月1日起，將非旺季航段調至新台幣350元，旺季航段調至450元。長榮航空與立榮航空自8月起調漲非自菲律賓與香港出發的國際線訂位費至33美元。中華航空則已於7月9日起，將該費用調升至30美元。

en.title: STARLUX Airlines to Raise Booking Service Fee to $33 in October
en.summary: STARLUX Airlines will raise its booking service fee to $33 starting October 7.
body: STARLUX Airlines announced that it will raise its booking service fee from $30 USD to $33 USD starting October 7, 2026. The fee, which is processed through Global Distribution Systems (GDS) based on user-pays principles, is collected alongside flight tickets. This is the carrier's second adjustment this year, following an increase from $25 USD to $30 USD in April.

Other Taiwanese carriers have also raised their booking service fees in 2026. Tigerair Taiwan adjusted its fees starting September 1 to NT$350 per segment for off-peak flights and NT$450 for peak flights. EVA Air and UNI Air raised their fee to $33 USD in August for departures outside of the Philippines and Hong Kong, while China Airlines increased its fee to $30 USD starting July 9.
